committed_cycle.completion: Outbox empty after bounded drains on an independent connection; dispatcher committed; all three LiveViews rendered; both record revisions match storage; delivery failure and retry visible without a new ticket revision

collaboration_matrix.completion: Presence refs observed on PubSub, tracker barrier completed, then every view rendered; saves committed and outbox empty; losing same-section drafts preserved; independent-section saves both committed
collaboration_matrix.limitations: One connected record per distinct staff user, one organization per case, four runtime connections; HTTP mounts are sequential, heartbeat/save bursts use a start barrier; draft events are delivered after client debounce; no browser timing, network or polling delay. Presence follow-up SQL is included. Each connected case must finish before the 30-second reconciliation timer. Timings include assertions and observers.

committed_cycle.limitations: Local synthetic workload, not a capacity estimate. HTTP/LiveView protocol driven in-process; no browser/network latency. Workers invoked explicitly without poll delay. Legacy scenarios exclude presence heartbeats; the collaboration matrix includes explicit heartbeat events. Recovery timers excluded. Operator-only validation queries excluded. Only the outer window traces leases; nested phase query counters add overhead. Control measures one probe pair and includes separate setup/teardown cost. Lease boundaries exclude final handoff bookkeeping.
